Opportunity relayed for Siméon Campos:

_Humanis is hiring for a Chief of Staff. ($125k - $200k + equity)_

_Ideal profile = 
- Fast-moving
- Excellent generalist
- High conscientiousness
- Keen to grow fast and be in the front seat of running a fast-growing startup. 
Our mission is to enable formal verification to apply to the entire world, to be able to use frontier AI without having to trust it. You can find the job ad here: <https://humanis.ai/careers/chief-of-staff/|https://humanis.ai/careers/chief-of-staff/>_

_About Humanis: We, Humanis, an AI safety startup building verification infrastructure to broadly formally verify AI outputs both in the physical and the cyber world._

_We’re cofounded by me, previously founder & CEO of SaferAI and before that creator of ML4Good, Davidad (David Dalrymple), youngest MIT grad student ever at 16, previously Programme Director of a $70M “Safeguarded AI” ARIA programme on provably safe AI, and Otter Quarks, formerly engineer in safety critical industries like nuclear micro-reactors and aerospace._

*We're accepting applications for the sixth iteration of the AI Security Bootcamp!*

<https://aisb.dev|AI Security Bootcamp> is a fully funded program for senior security professionals shaping how we secure frontier AI systems.

AISB is a 7-day intensive focused on the risks as frontier AI systems become more capable and are targeted by sophisticated attacks. The program covers threat modeling, adversarial attacks, LLM security, infrastructure controls, weight security, formal verification, data center security, AI control, and hardware governance.

We are looking for senior security professionals with 5+ years of experience. No AI or ML background required. Past participants have been affiliated with OpenAI, Anthropic, Nvidia, Google, Meta, Apple, Microsoft, AWS, Stanford, MIT, Oxford, Cambridge, and national security agencies.

Applications close 1st Oct. We review on a rolling basis and encourage you to apply as early as possible.

<https://airtable.com/appyq1bBRnK6s7AkM/paglvXzxYAiJclCZX/form|Apply here>, or learn more at <https://aisb.dev/london|aisb.dev/london>
